The priests too were busy in church and chapel, in lying against
and perverting the written Word, and thus inspiring the people with
violence, hatred and every cruel work; yet we found the Saints
rejoicing in the truth, and the honest in heart disposed to inquire
into it.

“ And now I make an end of speaking onto you concerning this pride. And were it not that I must speak unto you concerning a grosser crime, my heart would rejoice exceedingly, because of you. But the word of God burthens me because of youx grosser crimes. For behold, thus saith the Lord, This people begin to wax in iniquity : they understand not the Scriptures ; for they seek to excuse themselves…
